source: Solar constant: NASA NSSDCA Sun fact sheet. Margins: NASA mass and power margin practice at preliminary design (GSFC-STD-1000 Gold Rules, about 20-30%). Link reference: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (100 W X-band, 3 m antenna, about 0.5 Mbps to a 34 m Deep Space Network antenna at 2.67 au; NASA MRO telecommunications fact sheet), scaled to 1 W, 1 m and 1 au. Schedule risk by technology readiness level and the redundancy and tier factors are game balance values.
units: Margins and fractions are 0-1. link_reference gives the downlink rate of a 1 W transmitter with a 1 m antenna at 1 au into a 34 m ground antenna.
